# @jfmoe/smart-search 0.7.2

## Project transition

- Directs npm users to the Rust rewrite at [jfmoe/forager](https://github.com/jfmoe/forager).
- Prints the forager repository and Skill installation command during npm postinstall.
- Keeps the Python package installable as a lightweight recovery path while the full npm version
  range is deprecated rather than unpublished.
